_comment: Protected-paths SSOT for the unified 03:00 batch runner's merge predicate (ADR-0105, meeting 2026-11-12). A PR touching any pattern in protectedPaths is hold-for-human-merge: the runner must never merge it, regardless of gate status. Patterns are gitignore-style globs evaluated from the repository root. L0-only - never propagated to templates/ or scaffolded projects. Consumers: the runner prompt's merge predicate (cited by reference) and human PR review. Machine-readable counterpart of ADR-0105 Decision 2.
note: Decision of record: docs/adr/0105-unified-batch-runner.md (Decision 2, protected paths hold-for-human-merge). Changes to this file are themselves protected and merge only via human review. See also docs/designs/2026-11-12-unified-batch-runner-design.md (AC-3). | v2026-11-20 (meeting 2026-11-20, security-expert finding): this file now lists ITSELF plus the runner-executed gate scripts (upgrade-project, ticket, run-manifest, stop-gate, battery, verify-delivered-versions, contained-run) — previously the list protected the docs it named but not the code the runner executes nor the list itself, so a CLEAN-mergeable PR could delete an entry and widen the next night's merges. | v2026-11-21 (DEC-20261120-01, runner-hardening PR-1): fleetParityCarveOut added — an EXACT enumeration (no globs, so a NEW hook file cannot self-sanction its fleet delivery) of the six engine-delivered enforcement files; FLEET-repo merges of these paths are sanctioned only under the carve-out's conditions (upgrade-wave PR that passed the STEP I gates + blob byte-identical to the template source at the delivered version + verify-delivered-versions.ts exit 0); ROOT-repo merges touching these paths remain HOLD; membership changes are human-only (this file is protected).

fleetParityCarveOut.comment: Paths the runner MAY merge in FLEET repos (Projects/co-*) when the PR is an upgrade-wave delivery whose diff for these paths is byte-identical to the template source at the delivered version. Root-repo merges touching these paths remain HOLD. Membership changes are human-only (this file is protected). Seeded 2026-11-20 per DEC-20261120-01 with the T-20261116-002 defect-fix channel.

outOfRepoProtected.name: automation prompts
outOfRepoProtected.reason: The runner's own prompt surface. Out-of-repo vector documented as preserved dissent S2 (meeting 2026-11-12): prompt self-edits are invisible to every in-repo gate. Detection layer: prompts.manifest.json carries the expected SHA256 of each authority-bearing prompt (landed via T-20261112-003). The prompt-integrity verifier itself is NOT yet armed — the manifest currently ratifies the live store text as v5 (2026-11-20 ratification; runner-v5.snapshot.txt), and scripts/verify-prompt-integrity.ts plus its out-of-process host launchd schedule (06:00 KST, DEC-20261120-04) land in the follow-up verifier PR; detection is zero until then, so this invariant must not be described as enforced. The launcher-side pre-fire hash gate remains a platform ask.
